summary.plain: A nuclear power plant on the Rhine in northern Switzerland, hosting the relocated CONUS+ experiment just under 21 metres from the reactor core since late 2023.
summary.technical: Surface site of the Leibstadt boiling water reactor, Aargau, Switzerland; hosts the CONUS+ CEvNS detector 20.7 m from the reactor core since November 2023.
